entries: flirt shamelessly with whoever speaks to you next
hold eye contact a beat too long with whoever you're talking to
speak to whoever is across from you like you're trying to get their number
respond to everything the person on your right says like it turns you on
treat every question someone asks you like it's an invitation
every time someone makes you laugh, tell them it's your favorite thing about them so far
every time you talk to the person on your right, compliment their body first
tell whoever you're speaking to that you weren't expecting them to be your type
every time you agree with the person across from you, make it sound like the two of you are dangerously compatible
give the person on your left a new pet name every time you speak to them. Nothing you'd call a friend
say the name of whoever you're talking to in every sentence, and enjoy it a little too much
phrase everything you say to the person on your left as an offer they could take you up on tonight
take everything anyone says as innuendo, and let them know you caught it
deliver every boring sentence like it's the filthiest one you've ever said
give every story you tell a romantic or sexual angle
act like you and the person on your right hooked up once. Bring it up constantly
treat the person across from you like they came here as your date
every time the person on your left talks to someone else, act quietly wounded, like the two of you had an understanding
you can't make a point without a hand on the arm of whoever you're talking to, and you're in no rush to take it back
close the gap between you and the person on your left a little more every time you speak to them. Never give the space back
every time you pass something to someone, make sure your hands touch and let the handoff last longer than it should
keep your body angled toward the person on your right no matter who's talking. They're the only one you're interested in
whenever anyone touches you, even by accident, react like it meant something
whenever anyone says your name, react like they just said something dirty
treat every small favor anyone does for you as a move they're making on you, and say so out loud
the only questions you're allowed to ask are ones you'd ask someone you were trying to take home
whoever asks you a question has to work for the answer. Give it up slowly
keep suggesting to the person across from you that you two leave together
